arxiv-2410-08024.description: Abstract We evaluate the impact of pretraining Graph Transformer architectures on atom-level quantum-mechanical features for the modeling of absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties of drug-like compounds. arxiv-2510-22393.title: Davis-Kahan Theorem under a moderate gap condition Thanks: Department of Mathematics, Yale University, 10 Hillhouse Ave, New Haven, Connecticut, USA; phuc.tran@yale.edu, van.vu@yale.edu
arxiv-2510-22393.creator: Phuc Tran, Van Vu
arxiv-2510-22393.description: Abstract . The classical Davis-Kahan theorem provides an efficient bound on the perturbation of eigenspaces of a matrix under a large (eigenvalue) gap condition. In this paper, we consider the case when the gap is moderate. Using a bootstrapping argument, we obtain a new bound which is efficient when the perturbation matrix is uncorrelated to the ground matrix.

pmc-10620625.creator: Peter Pacut, Jee-Young Han, Mehdi Ghasemi
pmc-10620625.description: Rhinolalia aperta (hypernasal speech) is rarely reported in patients with Miller-Fisher syndrome (MFS). Here, we report a patient with MFS who presented with rhinolalia aperta. A 35-year-old man with a history of alcohol abuse and hepatic cirrhosis presented with a three-day acute hypernasal voice change and numbness of both hands/thighs.

pmc-10704956.title: Recent insights into the pathogenesis and therapeutic targets of chronic liver diseases
pmc-10704956.creator: Yankai Wen, Lichun Ma, Cynthia Ju
pmc-10704956.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Viral hepatitis, alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) are the three major causes of chronic liver diseases, which account for approximately 2 million deaths per year worldwide. The current direct-acting antiviral drugs and vaccinations have effectively reduced and ameliorated viral hepatitis infection, but there are still no effective drug treatments for ALD, NAFLD and liver cancer due to the poor understanding of their pathogenesis.

pmc-13598220.creator: Hatice Zora, Peter Hagoort, Aslı Özyürek
pmc-13598220.description: SignificanceContrary to classical unimodal linguistic theories, there is growing consensus supporting the view of language as a multimodal system.
